title: Albert Guichard and the Robichaux band
summary: Teachers who inspired him included Albert Guichard of Joe Robichaux's Paradise Inn unit; talk turns to George Lewis.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: Well I'll tell you there were some of them, two other fellas that more or less inspired

me and had worked from time to time as a teacher of mine, and whom I liked very much, and liked the styles very much. I don't know whether you've had the occasion to meet a fellow by the name of Albert Gishard. No. But he played with the Robichaud unit. They had a terrific unit there. That was during the time when they used to work at a place on Rampart Street called the Paradise Inn.
Joe Robichaud, yeah. George Lewis now. Oh is he playing again?
And he played with Lizzie Miles for several years.
He was on television with Lizzie in February. Is that right? I thought he had some other means. No. No. Because when I saw him several years ago on a visit home. He'd be here next week.
